properties.description: Generic Copy pipeline for incremental load PMM (DB2) and CFD

activities.name: COPY_SRC_DB2_DATA_TO_ADLS
activities.description: Copy Generic DB2 Data to Data Lake

query.value:
SELECT * FROM @{pipeline().parameters.dbvalue}@{pipeline().parameters.databaseName}.@{pipeline().parameters.tableName}
WHERE @{pipeline().parameters.watermarkColumnName} > TIMESTAMP_FORMAT(REPLACE('@{activity('LKP_GET_PREV_MAXDATE').output.firstRow.Watermark_Value}','T',''),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS:NNNNNN')  
and @{pipeline().parameters.watermarkColumnName} <='@{activity('LKP_GET_MAXDATE').output.firstRow.max_updated_time}'
FOR FETCH ONLY WITH UR

activities.name: LKP_GET_MAXDATE
activities.description: Get the latest max watermark date from database

query.value: SELECT max(@{pipeline().parameters.WatermarkColumnName}) as max_updated_time FROM @{pipeline().parameters.dbvalue}@{pipeline().parameters.databaseName}.@{pipeline().parameters.tableName} FOR FETCH ONLY WITH UR
